get.summary: Retrieve list of Account Activity for your account.
get.description:
Get request URI contain the following query options

$top (required): total number of results to display. Data Type: integer. Example: $top=25

$skip (required): skips the top number of results. Data Type: integer. Example: $skip=1

$filter (required): filters down results. Data Type: string. Example: date%20eq%20%27null%27%20and%20type%20eq%20%27null%27%20and%20startDate%20eq%20%272018-10-03T05.00.00%27%20and%20endDate%20eq%20%272018-10-06T04.59.59%27

$search (optional): search for specific result. Data Type: string. Example: $search=file%20restore

$orderby (optional): order by column name (name, location, status). Data Type: string. Example: $orderby=startTime%20desc

Times are submited as UTC
